What the Vite starter teaches you

When you scaffold a new project, the generated component shows a counter and a hint about hot module replacement. This is what the hint looks like in the generated file:

<p>Edit <code>src/App.tsx</code> and save to test HMR</p>

Replace that component with your own home page before you ship. In this post we look at each file in the template and what you should change before going live.
